name: Settler Rush
tagline: Will humans or AI colonize Catan first?
cta: Play Catan vs leading AI at
style: photorealistic cinematic film still, epic historical-fantasy realism, warm golden-hour sunlight, rich teal-and-amber color grade, volumetric light, shallow depth of field, highly detailed, set on a Catan-inspired island of hexagonal terrain patches: golden wheat fields, dense pine forests, rocky grey mountains, green sheep pastures, red clay brick hills, turquoise sea

red_tribe.label: Red Tribe
red_tribe.look: medieval human settlers in worn red-brown linen tunics and leather belts, rugged faces, red banners with a golden lion crest

openai.label: 5.6 Sol
openai.look: sleek matte-black armored humanoid robots with a glowing white interlocking-knot emblem on the chest and teal accent lights

anthropic.label: Anthropic
anthropic.look: tall robots in hooded dark-brown cloaks over cream-white armor plates painted with an orange starburst emblem, glowing amber visor, orange starburst banners

gemini.label: Gemini
gemini.look: polished blue-silver humanoid robots with a glowing four-point star emblem, sapphire light strips

deepseek.label: DeepSeek
deepseek.look: deep-indigo armored robots with a whale emblem, cold blue lights

episodes.title: Rushing to Settle Catan
episodes.summary: Red Tribe lands and finishes the first settlement; OpenAI 5.6 Sol, Anthropic and an unnamed gold AI land with boats and build a settlement tower in seconds.

episodes.title: Largest Army
episodes.summary: Boxed in by a road block, Anthropic pivots to development cards, plays three knights, robs Red Tribe of wheat, ore and sheep and claims Largest Army.
